purpose: A single choice between two to five short options of the same data, shown as one track with the chosen segment raised. Use it for switches like Day / Week / Month.

notFor.case: Long labels or more than five options.
Several independent actions side by side.
A single setting that is on or off.

Default.visual: A Surface/muted track holding the segments; exactly one is checked.

a11y.keyboard: One tab stop (the checked option). ArrowRight / ArrowDown select the next option, ArrowLeft / ArrowUp the previous (both wrap), Home / End the first / last; disabled options are skipped.
notes: Needs an aria-label or a visible label from the app.

openQuestions: Contrast: unchecked labels are Content/secondary on Surface/muted, 4.22:1 in Light, under AA. Fix the role or accept?
There is no way to disable the whole control, only single items. Is a group-level Disabled needed?
